terms.title: Government fees are additional
terms.text: FSSAI statutory fees, laboratory charges, certification expenses and third-party costs are not included unless stated.

terms.title: Fees depend on complexity
terms.text: Prices are indicative starting points. The final fee depends on the category, formulation complexity, number of SKUs, the regulatory pathway and the quality of the documents. If the work turns out larger, the expert sends a top-up quote before doing it.

terms.title: What counts as a SKU
terms.text: One SKU is one distinct artwork or formulation. A change of flavour, formulation or declarations may be a separate SKU.

terms.title: Complete information needed
terms.text: Conclusions depend on accurate formulations, specifications, certificates, artwork and information from you.

terms.title: Final formulation required
terms.text: If ingredient percentages, compound-ingredient composition, additive quantities or other essentials are incomplete, only a preliminary assessment can be given.

terms.title: Laboratory testing is separate
terms.text: Regulatory review does not include laboratory testing unless specifically commissioned.

terms.title: Authority decisions
terms.text: Professional regulatory support cannot guarantee approval by FSSAI or any other authority.

sections.title: FSSAI registration & licensing

services.name: Basic FSSAI Registration

Document checklist and review of your ID and address proof

A guided filing session with you on FoSCoS
services.deliverable: A filed registration application and its reference number
services.turnaround: 2–3 working days after documents are complete
